nl.title: Eén website terugzetten zonder andere sites te overschrijven
nl.excerpt: Eén website terugzetten zonder andere sites te overschrijven: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Zet één website terug zonder andere vhosts te overschrijven: selectieve restore van files + database van die owner.

Stappen

  1. Identificeer de juiste backupset (datum + sitenaam).
  2. Suspend of maintenance op die site tijdens restore.
  3. Restore alleen die website/user — niet ‘hele server’ tenzij bedoeld.
  4. Importeer bijbehorende database.
  5. Test HTTPS, login en kritieke formulieren.

Let op: Verkeerde backup over de verkeerde user is destructief — dubbelcheck namen.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Backups maken; delete site safe; DB-only backup.

en.excerpt: Restore one website without overwriting other sites: steps in CyberPanel for restore, one, website.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Restore one website without overwriting other sites. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on restore, one, website — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: restore, one, website
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open CyberPanel and look specifically for settings around restore, one, website.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on restore.
  4. Apply the one update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Confirm what the backup includes (files/DB/mail) for restore, one, website and where the offsite copy lives.
  7. Where possible run a restore test to a safe target before overwriting production.

Verify

  • Result for restore, one, website matches “Restore one website without overwriting other sites”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside restore one website
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get restore, one, website right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if restore, one, website touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel, backups, tickets.
